profile.headline: Software Developer | Agentic AI | Java | Spring-Boot | Full Stack-Developer | Gen-AI | Python | CSE Grad @ Northeastern University
profile.summary: I am a Software Engineer with hands-on experience in backend, cloud, and full-stack development. At Vicor Corporation, I develop and optimize enterprise-grade backend systems using Java, Spring Boot, Hibernate, REST APIs, and CI/CD pipelines, achieving a 70% improvement in performance and 95% test coverage across microservices. Previously at Crest Data System, I worked on full-stack applications, transitioning from React to Vue, and built scalable backends with Node.js, MySQL, Redis, and AWS workflows (EC2, Lambda, S3, EBS), which boosted efficiency by 25–40% through cloud integration and automation.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Built Java (Spring Boot, JDBC, Jackson) services processing credit card data from Chase, AmEx, Discover, and
Capital One via SQL, AWS S3 SDK, and REST APIs, deployed through Maven/Jenkins CI/CD.
• Built a centralized logging and alerting system using Grafana, Loki, and Promtail, monitoring 1,000+ cron-scheduled
programs across Linux and Windows servers and replacing manual log checks on each server.
• Built a multithreaded Java data transfer service using ExecutorService and CompletableFuture, reducing nightly trans-
fer runtime from 3 hours to 10–12 minutes and moving 50+ TB to date.
• Automated a DocStar CRM integration with AI document classification and routing, using event-driven workflows, confidence-
threshold routing, and incremental metadata sync, cutting a process that took 24-hours down to 30-minutes
• Integrated intermediary service layers with backend payment platforms, deploying 15+ Docker-containerized services
on Kubernetes (AWS EKS) through Jenkins/Maven CI/CD pipelines to support reliable, stable production release

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Developed and maintained enterprise-grade backend applications leveraging Java EE, Spring Boot, and Hibernate,
delivering scalable and high-performance solutions.
• Contributed to Eng-Data Web Service, a backend-only system consolidating codebases from multiple projects, enhanced
Java-based microservices running on Tomcat with Spring Boot for seamless deployment and maintenance.
• Designed efficient GraphQL queries and resolvers integrated with JPA/Hibernate ORM, optimizing data retrieval and
reducing API response time from 8s to 2s, improving throughput by 70%.
• Deployed and managed scalable, fault-tolerant AWS cloud workflows using Lambda, EC2, S3, DynamoDB, and Docker,
supported by automated CI/CD pipelines via Git, Maven, and Jenkins for seamless deployment.
• Integrated AI-driven log anomaly detection and predictive maintenance models using Python and AWS SageMaker,
backed by 95% JUnit test coverage and regression testing, reducing post-deployment failures by 25%

positions.title: Graduate Teaching Assistant
positions.description:
• Mentored 100 students in data-structures and algorithms, C++ and Python OOPs concepts.
• Conducted TA sessionsfor more than 6 hours a week to clarify doubtsrelated to different data structureslike trees, graphs,
and tries, while evaluating and providing constructive feedback on assignments
positions.insights: Python (Programming Language), Data Structures and +2 skills

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
• Worked on the Team Planner tool, a resource management system, using Agile methodologies to automate and
streamline resource allocation, reducing manual effort and allocation time by 40%.
• Participated in Backend development of Team Planner with Node.js and MySQL for database with Redis
 managing cache resulting in a 40% increase in project success.
• Designed intuitive interfaces and streamlined the ’Request Resource’ feature, initially developed in React.js
and later transitioned to Vue.js, Vuetify, and Vuex, leveraging JavaScript asynchronous operations.
• Implemented workflows with EC2 instances and serverless AWS Lambda functions, alongside storage workflows utilizing
S3 and EBS volumes and created CI/CD pipeline, resulting in a 25% increase in overall utilization.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
•Acquired proficiency in Vue.js and JavaScript, gaining the skills needed to create dynamic user interface.
•Utilized Jira for efficient project tracking and Bitbucket for streamlined code version control.
•Played a pivotal role in enhancing Team Planner, a resource management project, resulting in a 20% increase in employee utilization and a significant improvement in operational efficiency for the company.
•Transitioned from training to actively contributing to the development of Team Planner’s User Interface, eventually securing a full-time position.

projects.title: xCollateral
projects.description: Overcollateralized DeFi using XRPL's AMM & side chains for a swift, secure solution. Creating xCollateral stemmed from recognizing XRPL's inherent capabilities. Its powerful built-in features, like the AMM for quick token swaps, inspired the vision. I saw the potential in leveraging these tools—bridges, side chains—to craft a platform that's not just powerful but also secure and lightning-fast on-chain.

projects.title: Airline Management System

and reservations, improving accessibility and integrity by 40%.
• Utilized Power BI and Tabulo for data visualization and analysis, providing actionable insights into Project
